title: Simu Liu's Cryptic Posts Fuel Monday Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Speculation
excerpt:
Two Instagram Stories from Simu Liu have renewed speculation about a Doomsday trailer.
Marvel has not officially confirmed a Monday release date.
body_md:
Marvel fans are once again searching actors' social-media posts for clues about the next Avengers: Doomsday trailer. Two brief Instagram Stories from Simu Liu, who plays Shang-Chi, have prompted speculation that new footage could arrive on Monday, November 23, 2026. The suggested date remains unconfirmed by Marvel Studios.

One of Liu's posts featured a clock emoji displaying 10:10, while another contained a winking face. Some fans have interpreted the combination as a deliberately cryptic countdown or a hint about an imminent trailer. Neither image, however, explicitly names a trailer or supplies an official release time. The interpretation belongs to the audience, not to a confirmed studio announcement.

Hayley Atwell, known for playing Peggy Carter in the MCU, had also previously hinted at forthcoming promotional material. Taken together, the two actors' remarks have increased anticipation. But hints and promotional speculation are not equivalent to a formal release schedule, particularly when major franchise campaigns can change at short notice.

Earlier promotional material for Doomsday has gradually revealed more of the film's cast and its central confrontation. According to the report, one trailer showed heroes preparing to face Doctor Doom, while more recent footage offered a closer look at Doom and Captain America. Robert Downey Jr.'s portrayal of Doom remains a central point of interest for viewers waiting to see more of the movie.

The article also explores how Marvel's Time Runs Out comics, with their universe-threatening incursions, have shaped fan expectations. Speculation ranges from a collision between the Avengers' world and an X-Men reality to appearances involving other familiar cinematic universes. These possibilities are not established plot details, and the report does not confirm any of the more dramatic scenarios.

Fans have additionally wondered whether an emotionally charged trailer might suggest a major death or the destruction of a beloved fictional world. It is equally possible that Marvel would preserve its biggest surprises for the finished film and instead emphasize the return of familiar characters and the emotional history audiences associate with them. No trailer footage substantiating those theories has been presented here.

For now, the concrete development is a pair of ambiguous posts that have reignited conversation. Whether Marvel releases a trailer on Monday remains to be seen. Until the studio publishes the video or announces a date, the rumored timing and content should be treated as speculation rather than confirmed news.
seo_title: Is a New Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Coming Monday?
seo_description: Simu Liu's clock and wink Instagram Stories have sparked fresh Avengers: Doomsday trailer speculation, but no official date is confirmed.
